---
name: Create CBW Dashboard
description: 'Create a CBW operational dashboard from the dashboard template catalog.'
argument-hint: 'Decision, measures, dimensions, real data source, and route.'
agent: agent
---

Use `create-cbw-screen` and `select-cbw-chart`. Select a dashboard source from [template-patterns.md](../../references/template-patterns.md), establish the operational question for every KPI or chart, then build the screen using real CBW data and all relevant states.
